summary: Veea Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its August 5, 2026 8-K to disclose a Separation Agreement with Randal Stephenson dated August 11, 2026, relating to his departure. The original 8-K reported unsecured demand loans from NLabs Inc., an affiliate of the CEO and principal stockholder, totaling $600,000 ($500,000 and $100,000) at 10% interest, due December 31, 2026 or on demand. The loans are for working capital. This is routine financing and an executive departure disclosure, not a special situation.
